blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project
blocks.zh: 大部分未来预测的世界模型优先考虑生成的视频的节拍质量,但由于缺乏明确的4D模型,只能提供薄弱的物理地面和一段时间内有限的几何一致性. 在本文中,我们引入了plan4d,这是建立基因可规划的4D世界模型的下一个可能里程碑,该模型将预测未来的RGB视频与密集的4D几何,包括深度,摄像头,点云,以及从观测到的场景背景和文字特定动作中流出的场景. 由于配对动作和密集的4D说明的培训数据本来就稀缺,计划4d利用了基础视频生成器和3D重建器的补充前身。 具体来说,我们提出一个模型式的刻板结构,让“深度的任何事3”与“长卡特视频”结合,并用一个辅助的DPT头进行场景流预测。 由此形成的模型使我们能够在动态的3D场景中规划和产生复杂,长视距,精细的动作,同时大幅度提高生成的未来视频的视觉忠实度和几何精度. 对合成和现实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,plan4d在环境反应的基因化4D模型化方面实现了最先进的性能. 项目网页:https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Given an observed scene context and a set of text-specified actions,
we consider the task of generative plannable 4D worlds ,
a new paradigm for predicting reliable futures for the physical world that jointly produces visually plausible RGB frames and physically grounded 4D geometry –including depth, camera dynamics, and scene flow –within a single feed-forward model.
Prior observation-prediction models formulate future prediction largely as RGB synthesis [ 25 , 86 ] , often on a per-frame basis,
notably UniSim [ 106 ] , Genie 1–3 [ 13 , 76 , 8 ] , NWM [ 10 ] , and V-JEPA 2 [ 4 ] .
By contrast,
with our actionable 4D future world model,
humans and AI agents can plan and execute complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in the explicit 3D environment,
such as picking up a cup, opening a bottle, or navigating through a cluttered room.
These dynamic 3D quantities are essential for accurate measurement, reliable simulation, and effective execution of downstream tasks [ 54 , 24 , 59 , 41 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个可观察到的场景背景和一组文字特定动作,
我们考虑基因计划4D世界的任务,
一个预测物理世界可靠未来的新范式,这个范式在单一的向导模型中,共同产生视觉上可信的RGB框架和被实体化的4D几何学 — — 包括深度、相机动态和场景流动。
先前的观测预测模型主要作为RGB合成[25,86]提出未来的预测,通常按每方框架进行,
特别是UniSim [106],Genie 1–3 [13],76,8],NWM [10],和V-JEPA 2 [4].
相比之下,
与我们可操作的4D未来世界模式,
人类和人工智能特工可以在明确的3D环境中规划和执行复杂、长距离和精细的行动,
比如拿起杯子,打开一瓶,或者通过一个杂乱无章的房间航行.
这些动态三维量对于准确测量、可靠的模拟和有效执行下游任务[54、24、59、41、33]至关重要。

blocks.en:
A major bottleneck of this task is the lack of suitable datasets,
namely action-conditioned video sequences paired with rich text and comprehensive 3D annotations,
including camera trajectories, accurate dense depth and motion.
For example,
large-scale video-caption datasets [ 7 , 98 , 18 ] may still lack detailed captions for physical fine-grained actions;
the latest Action-100M [ 15 ] dataset provides detailed action annotations but without 3D annotations,
while most dynamic 3D datasets [ 31 , 30 , 51 ] are relatively small in scale or lack natural actions.
blocks.zh:
这项任务的一个主要瓶颈是缺乏适当的数据集,
即带行动条件的视频序列,配有内容丰富的文本和综合3D说明,
包括相机轨迹,精确的密集深度和运动.
譬如说.
大型视频封装数据集[7、98、18]可能仍然缺乏关于有形精细行为的详细标题;
最新的Action-100M[15]数据集提供了详细的动作说明,但没有3D说明,
而大多数动态三维数据集[31,30,51]的规模相对较小或缺乏自然动作.

blocks.en:
Correspondingly,
powerful baselines have emerged in parallel on these separate data sources,
including video generators [ 35 , 12 , 11 , 81 , 34 , 53 , 108 , 90 , 66 , 87 ] ,
action-conditioned world models [ 106 , 13 , 76 , 8 , 10 , 4 , 48 , 58 ] ,
and 3D reconstructors [ 97 , 57 , 96 , 92 , 52 , 99 , 64 , 114 ] .
Despite being trained to build the same physical world,
these models still operate as isolated systems for particular tasks.
Standard pixel-level generators excel at synthesizing visually realistic RGB frames [ 102 ] ,
but typically lack physical consistency [ 101 , 61 ] ;
and 3D models recover explicit geometry well [ 95 ] but are largely reconstruction-centric and static.
Even advanced 4D frameworks [ 116 , 47 , 82 , 121 , 50 , 73 , 72 , 55 ] only infer motion from observed frames and cannot generate action-conditioned future worlds .
As a result, none of these families alone provides a generative plannable 4D world ,
in which appearance, geometry, camera and action-conditioned future dynamics evolve consistently over time.
blocks.zh:
因此,
在这些单独的数据来源上平行地出现了强有力的基线,
[35、12、11、81、34、53、108、90、66、87],
[106、13、76、8、10、4、48、58],
和3D重建器 [97, 57, 96, 92, 52, 99, 64, 114].
尽管被训练来建立同样的物理世界,
这些模型仍然作为用于特定任务的孤立系统运作。
标准像素级发电机在合成视觉现实的RGB帧[102]方面表现优异,
但通常缺乏物理一致性[101,61];
和3D模型恢复了显式几何井 [95],但主要是以重建为中心并静止.
甚至先进的4D框架[116, 47, 82, 121, 50, 73, 72, 55] 也只能从被观察到的框架推断出运动,不能产生有行动条件的未来世界.
因此,这些家庭没有一个单独提供 基因规划的4D世界。
其外观、几何、相机和有行动条件的未来动态随时间而不断演变。

blocks.en:
What if,
given these different dataset sources,
we stitch them together to model the same underlying 4D world?
To achieve such a generative plannable 4D world ,
we propose Plan4D ,
a unified framework for planning and generating dense 4D worlds from observed context and action descriptions.
Our core insight is to decouple the acquisition of strong geometric priors from the generation of future dynamics,
then reconnect them through a stitched latent world model that jointly plans RGB appearance and dense 4D geometry,
unlike recent methods [ 85 , 117 , 22 , 71 , 27 ] that attempt to learn a 4D world model’s geometry from scratch.
Such a paradigm reduces the task’s learning difficulty and data requirements,
while allowing us to leverage the powerful priors of pretrained video generators and 3D reconstructors to achieve complex, long-horizon and fine-grained dynamics.
blocks.zh:
狦...
鉴于这些不同的数据集来源,
我们把它们缝合起来 来模拟同样的4D世界?
为了实现这样一个基因计划 4D世界,
我们提出计划4D,
根据观察到的背景和行动描述规划和生成密集的四维世界的统一框架。
我们的核心洞察力是将获得的强几何前兆 与未来动态的生成脱钩
然后通过一个缝合的潜伏世界模型把它们重新连接起来,这个模型联合规划了RGB外观和稠密的4D几何,
与近期试图从零开始学习4D世界模型几何的方法[85,117,22,71,27]不同.
这种模式减少了任务的学习困难和数据要求,
同时让我们能够利用 预先训练的视频发电机和3D重建器的强大前科 实现复杂、长相和精细的动态。

blocks.en:
In practice,
this paradigm requires solving several coupled challenges.
i) the model must extend a frozen 3D foundation model from static scenes to dynamic 4D prediction while preserving its geometric consistency.
ii) it must align geometry tokens with the latent space of a video generator without destroying the pretrained generative prior.
iii) it must learn from real, unlabeled action videos without dense 4D supervision [ 112 ] .
iv) it must also ensure consistency across the generated RGB, depth, camera, point clouds, and scene flow.
Recent methods, including VIST3A [ 29 ] , Geometry Forcing [ 100 ] , and Gen3R [ 37 ] , couple 3D reconstructors with video generators for static text-to-3D or scene-level 3D generation.
We extend this direction to full actionable 4D world generation , jointly predicting full 4D geometry and appearance in future video sequences depicting fine-grained actions.
blocks.zh:
实际上,
这一模式需要解决若干相互关联的挑战。
(一)模型必须把被冻结的3D地基模型从静态场景扩展到动态4D预测,同时保持其几何一致性.
(二) 它必须使几何符号与视频生成器的潜在空间相配合,而不会破坏事先经过训练的基因。
iii)它必须学习真实的,无标签的动作视频,而无需密集的4D监督[112].
(四) 还必须确保生成的RGB、深度、相机、点云和场景流动的一致性。
近代方法,包括VIST3A [29],"几何要塞" [100],和Gen3R [37],配有视频发电机的夫妇3D重建器,用于静态文本到3D或场景级3D生成.
我们把这个方向延伸至完全可操作的四维世界代, 共同预测全四维几何 以及未来影像序列中的外观,

blocks.en:
Unlike prior approaches that use geometry mainly as an auxiliary constraint [ 100 , 6 , 110 , 26 , 3 ] ,
or decode geometry only after RGB generation [ 24 ] ,
our Plan4D turns a video generator into an actionable 4D world model,
which explicitly aligns future appearance and 4D structure inside the shared evolving video latent state. To preserve strong geometric priors while extending them beyond reconstruction, we augment Depth Anything 3 [ 64 ] (DA3) with a lightweight token-only scene-flow head that predicts dense forward 3D motion from intermediate geometry tokens,
while keeping its pretrained depth and camera-ray predictions intact.
To connect this geometric readout with future generation, we learn a latent-to-geometry stitching module that maps video VAE latents into a selected DA3 block and trains it with token distillation and geometric supervision.
The resulting stitched decoder provides a stable, differentiable interface from video latents to full 4D geometry.
We then train the video generator against this frozen geometric interface, so unlabeled action videos can supervise not only visual prediction but also physically grounded 4D consistency.
At inference time, a single generated latent future yields RGB frames and dense 4D geometry in one feed-forward pass.
blocks.zh:
与以前主要使用几何学作为辅助约束的方法不同[100, 6, 110, 26, 3],
或仅在RGB生成[24]后解码几何,
我们的计划4 D将视频生成器变成可操作的4D世界模型,
在共享的正在演化的视频潜伏状态下,它明确地调整了未来的外观和4D结构。 为了保留强几何前缀,同时将其延伸至重建之外,我们用一个轻量级的只显示符号的场景流头来增强深度Anything 3 [64] (DA3),通过中间几何符号来预测密集的向前三维运动,
同时保持其预先训练的深度和相机射线的预测完好无损.
为了把这种几何读取与下一代联系起来,我们学习了一个潜入几何缝合模块,将视频VAE潜入选定的DA3区块,并用符号分馏和几何监督来对其进行训练。
由此产生的接缝解码器提供了一个稳定,不同的界面,从视频潜入到全4D几何.
然后我们用这个被冻结的几何界面来训练视频生成器, 所以没有标签的动作视频不仅可以监督视觉预测, 还可以监督物理上被禁用的4D一致性。
在推论中,一个单一产生的潜在未来产生RGB帧和密密的4D几何在一条向后传输的通道.

blocks.en: Our main contributions can be summarized as follows: • We take a step towards the new paradigm of generative plannable 4D worlds , which jointly generates future RGB appearance and corresponding full 4D geometry, including depth, camera rays, point clouds, and scene flow, from observed context and action descriptions. • We propose Plan4D , a unified framework with a scene-flow head and a geometry-video stitching mechanism that connect a frozen 3D foundation model with a pretrained video generator, preserving geometric priors while enabling action-conditioned dynamic 4D future prediction from unlabeled videos. • We illustrate how Plan4D can achieve state-of-the-art performance in dense 4D world generation, improving both visual realism and geometric accuracy across scene flow, 3D reconstruction, and action-conditioned video prediction through extensive experiments.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献可归纳如下: 我们朝着基因可规划的4D世界的新范式迈出了一步,它共同产生未来的RGB外观和相应的全4D几何,包括深度,相机射线,点云和场景流,从所观察到的背景和行动描述. • 我们提出Plan4D,一个统一的框架,有一个场景流程头和几何-视频缝合机制,将被冻结的3D地基模型与预先训练的视频生成器连接起来,保存几何前缀,同时能够从没有标签的视频中进行行动条件的动态4D未来预测。 我们说明Plan4D如何在密集的4D世界代中实现最先进的性能,通过广泛的实验,提高场景流的视觉现实性和几何精度,3D重建,以及动作条件视频预测.

blocks.en: We take a step towards the new paradigm of generative plannable 4D worlds , which jointly generates future RGB appearance and corresponding full 4D geometry, including depth, camera rays, point clouds, and scene flow, from observed context and action descriptions.
blocks.zh: 我们朝着基因可规划的4D世界的新范式迈出了一步,它共同产生未来的RGB外观和相应的全4D几何,包括深度,相机射线,点云和场景流,从所观察到的背景和行动描述.

blocks.en: We propose Plan4D , a unified framework with a scene-flow head and a geometry-video stitching mechanism that connect a frozen 3D foundation model with a pretrained video generator, preserving geometric priors while enabling action-conditioned dynamic 4D future prediction from unlabeled videos.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Plan4D,一个具有场景流头和几何-视频缝合机制的统一框架,将被冻结的3D地基模型与预先训练的视频生成器连接起来,保存几何前缀,同时使行动有条件的动态4D未来从无标签视频中预测.

blocks.en: We illustrate how Plan4D can achieve state-of-the-art performance in dense 4D world generation, improving both visual realism and geometric accuracy across scene flow, 3D reconstruction, and action-conditioned video prediction through extensive experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们说明Plan4D如何能够在密集的4D世界一代中实现最先进的性能,通过广泛的实验,提高场景流的视觉现实主义和几何精度,3D重建,以及动作有条件的视频预测.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
4D world models. Recent work has begun to model 4D worlds from two complementary directions.
Explicit dynamics methods such as ParticleFormer [ 40 ] and PointWorld [ 41 ] predict particle trajectories or point-level motion, but mainly operate in structured 3D state spaces rather than generating rich future 4D.
4D-native generative models instead learn spatiotemporal world evolution, ranging from dynamic reconstruction, visual planning, and image-to-4D generation in Aether [ 85 ] and 4DNeX [ 21 ] , to RGB-D or geometry-aware scene generation in TesserAct [ 117 ] and Robo4DGen [ 69 ] . GWM [ 70 ] , iMoWM [ 113 ] , and Kinema4D [ 105 ] further explore Gaussian, tokenized, and kinematics-driven representations, while FantasyWorld [ 22 ] , WorldReel [ 27 ] , TeleWorld [ 20 ] , HY-World 2.0 [ 43 ] , and Lyra 2.0 [ 80 ] couple video generation with geometric prediction for more unified world modeling.
Despite this progress, existing systems typically emphasize either explicit geometric forecasting or large-scale generative simulation, and they rarely integrate the complementary priors of pretrained geometry foundation models into the latent dynamics of video generation.
blocks.zh:
4D世界模型. 最近的工作已经开始从两个互补方向来模拟4D世界.
如"粒子前传"[40]和"PointWorld"[41]等明确的动力学方法预测出粒子轨迹或点级运动,但主要在结构化的3D状态空间中运行,而不是产生丰富的未来4D.
取而代之的是4D-亲生遗传模型学习spatiotemporal世界演化,从Aether [85]和4DNeX [21] 的动态重建,视觉规划,以及图像到4D的生成,到TesserAct [117]和Robo4DGen [69]. GWM [70],iMoWM [113],和Kinema4D [105] 进一步探索高斯人,象征化,动能驱动的表达,而"最终幻想世界" [22],"世界Reel [27],"TeleWorld [20],"HY-World 2.0 [43],"Lyra 2.0 [80] 几组视频生成,并有几组几组几何预测,以更统一的世界模型.
尽管取得了这一进展,但现有系统通常强调明确的几何预测或大规模基因模拟,它们很少将预先训练的几何基础模型的互补前科纳入视频生成的潜在动态中.

blocks.en: Aligning 3D Reconstruction and Video Generation. Early uses of generative priors for 3D synthesis mostly follow a cascade, where geometric constraints are applied to generated outputs rather than to internal generative states [ 77 , 28 , 94 ] . Later methods tighten this link through reconstruction-guided diffusion or distillation, as in GenFusion [ 103 ] , VideoScene [ 91 ] , and Lyra [ 5 ] . Recent work moves the alignment into feature or latent spaces. Geometry Forcing [ 100 ] aligns intermediate diffusion features with pretrained geometric representations [ 111 ] , Gen3R [ 37 ] aligns geometry and appearance latents for joint generation, and GLD [ 46 ] repurposes geometric features as multi-view diffusion latents. From the model-stitching view [ 56 , 9 ] , VIST3A [ 29 ] connects a pretrained video VAE with a 3D network at linearly matchable layers. Our method builds on this direction, but stitches a video diffusion model to a 3D foundation model so that RGB synthesis and dense 4D geometry can be optimized and decoded from a shared latent rollout.
blocks.zh: 调整3D重建与视频生成. 3D合成的先入为主的早期用途大多遵循级联,其中几何限制适用于生成的输出,而不是内部的先入为主状态[77、28、94]。 后来的方法通过重建指导的传播或蒸馏来收紧这种联系,例如GenFusion [103],VideoScene [91],和Lyra[. 5] (英语). 近期的工作将对齐移入特征或潜在空间. 几何强迫 [100] 使中间扩散特征与预受训练的几何表示相协调 [111],GEN3R [37] 使几何和外观潜能结合生成,而GLD [46] 重新将几何特征作为多视扩散潜能. 从模型刻出视图[56,9],VIST3A[29]连接了经过预先训练的视频VAE和线性可匹配层的3D网络. 我们的方法建立在这个方向上,但将一个视频传播模型缝合到3D基础模型上,这样RGB合成和稠密的4D几何可以被优化,从共享的潜在推出中解码出.

blocks.en: 3 Plan4D
blocks.zh: 3 Plan4D 计划

blocks.en:
Given an observed context 𝒪 = { 𝑰 i } i = 1 M \mathcal{O}=\{\bm{I}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{M} and the planned action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} ,
our goal is to learn a generative plannable 4D world model f 𝜽 f_{\bm{\theta}} that is conditioned on 𝒪 \mathcal{O} and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and predicts a set of future 4D representations: f 𝜽 : { 𝒪 , 𝒜 } ↦ { 𝑰 t , 𝑫 t , 𝒓 t , 𝑽 t } t = 1 T , f_{\bm{\theta}}:\{\mathcal{O},\mathcal{A}\}\mapsto\{\bm{I}_{t},\bm{D}_{t},\bm{r}_{t},\bm{V}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T}, where 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is a sequence of textual action descriptions 𝒑 \bm{p} .
The model f 𝜽 f_{\bm{\theta}} learns a video latent trajectory that is conditioned on the observed context and the action description,
and reads out the future RGB video frames 𝑰 t ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \bm{I}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} ;
and its corresponding depth maps 𝑫 t ∈ ℝ H × W \bm{D}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} , camera ray maps 𝒓 t ∈ ℝ H × W × 6 \bm{r}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 6} , and full 4D scene flow 𝑽 t ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \bm{V}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} .
The ray maps 𝒓 t \bm{r}_{t} encode the camera origin and the ray directions for each pixel,
which can be used to reconstruct the 3D point cloud of the scene.
The scene flow 𝑽 t \bm{V}_{t} encodes the 3D motion of each pixel from time t t to t + 1 t+1 1 1 1 Since we only define the forward flow, we then simplify 𝑽 t → t + 1 \bm{V}_{t\to t+1} as 𝑽 t \bm{V}_{t} . .

blocks.en:
We parametrize f 𝜽 f_{\bm{\theta}} with a model-stitching architecture that couples a video generator, LongCat-Video [ 87 ] (which uses the Wan 2.1 VAE [ 90 ] ), with a foundational 3D reconstructor, Depth Anything 3 [ 64 ] (DA3).
The key insight is that,
by building on the pretrained video generator and 3D reconstructor,
our model can leverage the complementary priors of these two foundational models to achieve both high visual fidelity and strong geometric consistency in the generated future videos,
unlike training it from scratch [ 85 , 117 , 22 , 27 ] ,
which is extremely challenging and data-hungry.
To improve the motion modeling capability of DA3,
we first augment it with an auxiliary DPT-style scene flow head in section 3.1 .
In section 3.2 ,
we then stitch the video generator and the augmented DA3 together through a learnable latent-to-geometry stitching module,
followed by a distillation and geometric supervision process to calibrate the stitched model in section 3.3 .
Finally, we train the joint model in section 3.4 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Augmenting DA3 for Dynamic Scene Flow Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.1 动态场景流预测增强DA3

blocks.en:
The physical world is not a collection of independent per-frame geometries.
To model the dynamics and correspondence of the 4D world,
we augment DA3 [ 64 ] with a dense scene flow head that predicts the 3D motion of each pixel.
Following the original DPT-style decoder in DA3,
the new head ingests the four intermediate token maps of the frozen encoder,
and outputs a dense three-channel motion field via a lightweight prediction layer.
Note that,
the original encoder, as well as the depth and camera pose branches, remains unchanged; we simply add a dedicated motion branch.
Our analysis in Appendix A shows that frozen DA3 tokens already encode cross-frame motion cues, which supports using this branch as a lightweight readout rather than a full motion model.
In particular,
for each frame t t , the new head predicts a scene flow on the pixel lattice of that frame.
Each valid pixel stores the forward 3D displacement from time t t to t + 1 t+1 . The raw prediction is produced in the local camera basis of frame t t and is mapped to a common reference frame with a lightweight adapter, 𝑽 t ( 0 ) ​ ( u , v ) = 𝐑 t → 0 ​ 𝑽 t ( cam ) ​ ( u , v ) , \bm{V}^{(0)}_{t}(u,v)=\mathbf{R}_{t\rightarrow 0}\,\bm{V}^{(\mathrm{cam})}_{t}(u,v), (1) where 𝐑 t → 0 \mathbf{R}_{t\rightarrow 0} denotes the rotation from the camera basis of frame t t to the first-frame camera basis.
We apply only rotation because scene flow is a vector quantity rather than a 3D point.
This representation keeps spatial indexing local to each frame while expressing all motion vectors in a temporally stable basis.
As a result, the predicted dynamics remain consistent under camera motion and align naturally with the depth, ray, and point-based geometry produced by DA3.
Despite being a seemingly minor change,
the new head has a substantial effect in practice:
it consistently improves reconstruction, camera, and depth estimation quality on various dynamic scenes compared with stitched variants without motion modeling,
as shown in our experiments.

Following recent works in model stitching [ 75 , 29 , 37 ] ,
we design a simple learnable module to stitch the video generator and the augmented DA3 together,
allowing the video latent to be directly decoded into full 4D geometry,
including depth, camera poses, point clouds, and scene flow.
Let 𝑰 1 : T \bm{I}^{1:T} be a video clip and let 𝒛 0 1 : T = ℰ vae ( 𝑰 1 : T ) \bm{z}_{0}^{1:T}=\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{vae}}(\bm{I}^{1:T}) be its Wan 2.1 VAE latent [ 90 ] .
We first upsample the latent to the spatial and temporal resolution required by DA3: 𝒛 ~ 0 1 : T = Up ( s t , s h , s w ) ( 𝒛 0 1 : T ) ∈ ℝ ( s t ​ t ) × ( s h ​ h ) × ( s w ​ w ) × C . \tilde{\bm{z}}_{0}^{1:T}=\operatorname{Up}_{(s_{t},s_{h},s_{w})}(\bm{z}_{0}^{1:T})\in\mathbb{R}^{(s_{t}t)\times(s_{h}h)\times(s_{w}w)\times C}. A learnable 3D stitching module 𝒮 𝜽 \mathcal{S}_{\bm{\theta}} then maps the upsampled latent tensor into the channel dimension of a DA3 encoder block, 𝐡 ( k ) = 𝒮 𝜽 ( 𝒛 ~ 0 1 : T ) . \mathbf{h}^{(k)}=\mathcal{S}_{\bm{\theta}}\bigl(\tilde{\bm{z}}_{0}^{1:T}\bigr). In our implementation 𝒮 𝜽 \mathcal{S}_{\bm{\theta}} is a compact spatiotemporal projection, instantiated as a 3D convolution. Its temporal kernel aggregates neighboring latent frames, and its spatial stride matches the VAE grid to the DA3 patch grid.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stitched Decoder Finetuning
blocks.zh: 3.3 断接解码器微调

blocks.en:
Here,
we describe how to finetune the stitched decoder to adapt to the new latent input distribution and obtain accurate geometry predictions.
Unlike VIST3A [ 29 ] which only distills RGB features,
we employ a hybrid training strategy that combines teacher-student distillation with ground-truth (GT) supervision.
The teacher-student distillation follows the same principle as VIST3A,
where the teacher is the original frozen DA3 model augmented with the new scene flow head.
This teacher model takes the ground-truth RGB video clip as input and produces all types of 4D geometric outputs as supervision signals.
The student is the stitched decoder, which takes the Wan VAE latent of the same clip as input and produces the same set of geometric outputs.
For the GT supervision, we utilize the 3D annotations provided in the dataset as explicit regression targets.
blocks.zh:
这里
我们描述如何微调被缝接的解码器,以适应新的潜在输入分布并获得准确的几何预测.
与只提炼出RGB特性的VIST3A[29]不同,
我们采用混合培训战略,将师生分馏与地面实况监督相结合。
师生蒸馏遵循与VIST3A相同的原理,
其中老师是最初被冷冻的DA3型号,与新的场景流头相加.
这种师范模式将地真RGB视频剪辑作为输入,并产生出各种4D几何输出作为监督信号.
学生是被缝合的解码器,它取出与输入相同的剪辑所隐含的Wan VAE并产生同一套几何输出.
对于GT监督,我们利用数据集中提供的3D说明作为明确的回归目标.

Following the formulation in Lin et al. [64] , our training objective integrates dense geometric matching with spatial and temporal regularization constraints, ℒ geo = λ D ​ ℒ depth + λ R ​ ℒ ray + λ C ​ ℒ camera + λ M ​ ℒ motion + λ T ​ ℒ temporal . \mathcal{L}_{\text{geo}}=\lambda_{D}\mathcal{L}_{\text{depth}}+\lambda_{R}\mathcal{L}_{\text{ray}}+\lambda_{C}\mathcal{L}_{\text{camera}}+\lambda_{M}\mathcal{L}_{\text{motion}}+\lambda_{T}\mathcal{L}_{\text{temporal}}. (3) We also apply distillation to the depth and ray confidence maps using small weighting factors.
The training details are discussed in Appendix B in detail.
We keep the video diffusion transformer strictly frozen throughout this stage.
This entire training phase exclusively focuses on transforming the DA3 decoder into a robust geometric readout mechanism for the Wan latent space.

blocks.en: 3.4 Joint Video and 4D Geometry Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 联合视频和4D几何培训

blocks.en:
Once the stitched decoder is finetuned, we use it as a differentiable geometry critic for the video diffusion model.
The video model is trained with the standard latent flow-matching objective [ 115 ] .
For each clip, we sample a scalar diffusion time τ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tau\in[0,1] and use the corresponding scheduler noise scale σ τ ∈ ℝ \sigma_{\tau}\in\mathbb{R} .
Both values are shared by all latent frames in the clip and broadcast over space and channels.
Omitting the batch dimension, let 𝒛 τ 1 : T ∈ ℝ T ℓ × h × w × C z \bm{z}_{\tau}^{1:T}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{\ell}\times h\times w\times C_{z}} denote the noisy Wan latent trajectory at time τ \tau , where T ℓ T_{\ell} is the latent-frame length, ( h , w ) (h,w) is the VAE spatial grid, and C z = 16 C_{z}=16 for Wan.
The conditioning tuple c = ( 𝒆 𝒑 , 𝒛 ctx , 𝒎 ctx ) c=(\bm{e}_{\bm{p}},\bm{z}_{\mathrm{ctx}},\bm{m}_{\mathrm{ctx}}) contains the text-action embeddings 𝒆 𝒑 ∈ ℝ L p × d c \bm{e}_{\bm{p}}\in\mathbb{R}^{L_{p}\times d_{c}} and context-frame latents 𝒛 ctx ∈ ℝ T c × h × w × C z \bm{z}_{\mathrm{ctx}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{c}\times h\times w\times C_{z}} with a binary prefix mask 𝒎 ctx ∈ { 0 , 1 } T ℓ × h × w × 1 \bm{m}_{\mathrm{ctx}}\in\{0,1\}^{T_{\ell}\times h\times w\times 1} .
Given 𝒛 τ 1 : T \bm{z}_{\tau}^{1:T} , τ \tau , and c c , the diffusion transformer predicts a velocity field 𝒗 ϕ ( 𝒛 τ 1 : T , τ , c ) ∈ ℝ T ℓ × h × w × C z \bm{v}_{\phi}(\bm{z}_{\tau}^{1:T},\tau,c)\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{\ell}\times h\times w\times C_{z}} .
We convert the velocity prediction into a clean-latent estimate 𝒛 ^ 0 1 : T = 𝒛 τ 1 : T − σ τ 𝒗 ϕ ( 𝒛 τ 1 : T , τ , c ) , \hat{\bm{z}}_{0}^{1:T}=\bm{z}_{\tau}^{1:T}-\sigma_{\tau}\,\bm{v}_{\phi}(\bm{z}_{\tau}^{1:T},\tau,c), (4) where 𝒛 ^ 0 1 : T \hat{\bm{z}}_{0}^{1:T} has the same tensor shape as 𝒛 τ 1 : T \bm{z}_{\tau}^{1:T} and is passed directly into the frozen stitched decoder.
The joint objective is ℒ joint = ℒ FM + λ geo ​ ℒ geo ​ ( 𝒟 stitch ​ ( 𝒛 ^ 0 ) ) , \mathcal{L}_{\text{joint}}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{FM}}+\lambda_{\text{geo}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{geo}}\left(\mathcal{D}_{\text{stitch}}(\hat{\bm{z}}_{0})\right), (5) where ℒ FM \mathcal{L}_{\text{FM}} denotes the latent flow-matching loss and 𝒟 stitch \mathcal{D}_{\text{stitch}} represents the frozen stitched decoder.
The geometric penalty ℒ geo \mathcal{L}_{\text{geo}} is strictly identical to the objective formulated in Equation 3 .
During this joint optimization phase, we exclusively utilize the teacher-student distillation mechanism for action-conditioned videos.
As introduced previously, an independently loaded raw DA3 model serves as the teacher network.
It processes the ground-truth RGB clip to provide the reference targets for depth, ray maps, and scene flow. For image-to-video generation, the first frame is encoded as the conditioning prefix [ 87 ] . The diffusion loss can mask the conditioned prefix, while the geometry loss can be applied to the generated suffix.
As a result, Plan4D learns a single latent trajectory that must satisfy both appearance realism and dense 4D consistency. At inference time, the final latent sequence is decoded by the Wan VAE into RGB video and by the stitched DA3 decoder into depth, camera rays, and scene flow.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Implementation. Plan4D is trained in three stages on diverse datasets due to the lack of large-scale data with paired action and dense 4D annotations. (1) We train the designed scene-flow head on top of frozen DA3 using PointOdyssey [ 118 ] , Dynamic Replica [ 49 ] , Virtual KITTI 2 [ 14 ] , BlinkVision [ 62 ] , and OmniWorld-Game [ 119 ] for 20 epochs on 16 H100 GPUs. (2) We fit the latent-to-geometry stitching module on a small subset of the above datasets to initialize the interface from Wan latents to DA3 tokens.
Then we finetune the stitched decoder with the scene-flow-head data mixture augmented by ScanNet++ [ 109 ] and MVS-Synth [ 39 ] . This stage uses 64 H20 GPUs and runs one hybrid epoch over the full data mixture, where the same mixed sampling schedule is traversed once with ground-truth geometric supervision and once with teacher-student distillation. When a ground-truth-supervised sample does not provide scene-flow annotations, we set its scene-flow loss to zero. (3) We finally train the DiT on a subset of Action100M [ 15 ] for one epoch using 64 H20 GPUs. All stages use a per-GPU batch size of 1. Additional dataset details, optimization details, losses, and supervision definitions are provided in Appendix B .

然后我们用ScanNet++ [109] 和MVS-Synth [39] 扩充的场景流头数据混合物来微调所缝接的解码器. 这个阶段使用64个H20 GPU,并在全数据混合物上运行一个混合纪元,同一混合采样时间表一次由地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地--地-地-地-地-地-地-地--地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地--地-地-地--地--地--地-地-地-地--地------------- 当一个地面真实监督的样本没有提供场景流量说明时,我们将其场景流量损失设定为零. blocks.en: We evaluate Plan4D along three axes that correspond to its intended use as a generative 4D world model. (1) we evaluate dynamic 4D geometry through scene flow on MOVi-F [ 31 ] , Dynamic Replica, and PointOdyssey using 81-frame clips, and report endpoint error together with A ​ P ​ D 0.05 APD_{0.05} against reconstruction and motion baselines. (2) we test whether the stitched decoder preserves DA3 geometry after replacing the RGB encoder with a Wan-latent input pathway. This evaluation covers reconstruction, camera, and depth benchmarks, including ETH3D [ 79 ] , ScanNet++, Dynamic Replica, Dynamic-RE10K [ 19 ] , MOVi-F, and RobbySimVal [ 83 ] , with comparisons to RGB-based 3D foundation models and latent-to-geometry baselines. Scene-flow metrics are computed after rescaling predictions to the target point-map scale. Depth uses per-clip scale-shift alignment, while camera and reconstruction follow the official DA3 bench protocol, with first-camera pose alignment for relative-pose metrics and Umeyama scale alignment for reconstruction. (3) finally, we evaluate full action-conditioned 4D world generation on RLBench [ 45 ] (210 samples), HOIGen-1M [ 67 ] (200 samples), Dynamic Replica (480 samples), and PointOdyssey (375 samples). To further assess in-the-wild generalization, we additionally sample 100 five-second clips from Epic-Kitchens-100 [ 23 ] , which contains everyday human-object interactions in kitchen environments, and evaluate all compared methods under the same joint-generation protocol. These benchmarks test whether a single generated rollout can jointly preserve visual quality [ 65 , 120 ] , action-text alignment [ 16 ] , and temporally coherent 4D structure. We report video quality and instruction following with VBench-style video metrics and video-caption similarity [ 42 ] . For depth, reconstruction, and camera estimation, we follow the same protocol as the stitched-decoder evaluation. We compare with recent 4D world-generation and geometry-generation baselines, including VIST3A [ 29 ] , TesserAct [ 117 ] , and Gen3R [ 37 ] , on the modalities each method supports.
blocks.zh: 我们沿着三个轴线评估Plan4D,这与它作为基因四维世界模型的预期用途相符。 (1)我们用81个帧片段对MOVi-F [31],动态复制和PointOdyssey的场景流进行动态4D几何评价,并对照重建和运动基线报告端点误差以及A P D 0.05 APD _{0.05}。 (2)我们测试被缝接的解码器是否保留了DA3几何,在用万纬输入路径来取代RGB编码器后. 本评价涵盖重建,相机,和深度基准,包括ETH3D [79],ScanNet++,动态复制,Dynamic-RE10K [19],MOVi-F,和RobbySimVal [83],并与基于RGB的3D基础模型和潜到地理学基线进行比较. 场景流量度量衡在将预测调整到目标点-映射尺度后进行计算. 深度采用每克平面尺度-相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相位相位相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 (3)最后,我们评价在RL Bench [45] (210个样本)、HOIGEN-1M [67] (200个样本)、动态复制物(480个样本)和PointOdyssey (375个样本)上的全部行动条件4D世界一代。 为了进一步评估万事俱备的概括性,我们从Epic-Kitchens-100 [23] 中另外抽取出100个5秒的剪辑,这些剪辑包含了厨房环境中的日常人与物体的相互作用,并评价了同一联合生成协议下的所有比较方法. 这些基准检验单个生成的推出是否能够联合维护视觉质量[65,120],动作文本对接[16],以及时间上一致的4D结构. 我们用V Bench 风格的视频度量衡和视频封装相似性报告视频质量和指令[42]. 对于深度,重建和相机估计,我们遵循与缝合解码器评价相同的协议. 我们比较了最近的4D世界代和几何代基线,包括VIST3A[29]、Tester Act[117]和Gen3R[37],每种方法支持的模式。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Qualitative results for scene flow and dynamic reconstruction. Columns from left to right compare the ground truth, results from our DA3-based prediction, Any4D, and MotionCrafter.
Our result better preserves object-level motion and dynamic 3D structure while maintaining consistency with the reference geometry.
blocks.zh:
图3:现场流动和动态重建的定性结果. 从左到右的列比较了地面的真相,来自基于DA3的预测Any4D和MotionCrafter.
我们的结果更好地保留了对象级运动和动态三维结构,同时保持了与参考几何的一致性.

blocks.en:
We first test whether a frozen DA3 geometry prior can support dynamic 4D motion prediction beyond static reconstruction.
This is a stringent setting because scene flow requires temporally coherent geometry rather than accurate per-frame depth alone. Table 1 shows that both scene-flow variants remain competitive on all three benchmarks while using the smallest training set among the compared methods.
The RGB-based DA3 variant is particularly strong on the harder real dynamic benchmarks, suggesting that frozen DA3 tokens already support reliable dense 4D motion readout.
The stitched variant performs best on the controlled synthetic benchmark and remains near the top on Dynamic Replica, which matters because it is the decoder interface used during joint video training.
The qualitative results in Figure 3 show cleaner boundaries, more stable articulated motion, and better global 3D structure than the baselines.
Overall, these results validate the first step of Plan4D : DA3 can be extended from geometry reconstruction to strong dynamic 4D readout, and this capability largely survives the latent-to-geometry stitching step.
blocks.zh:
我们首先测试一个被冻结的DA3几何前端是否能够支持动态四维运动预测,超越静态重建.
这是一种严格的设定,因为场景流动需要时间上一致的几何学,而不只是每帧深度精确. 表1显示,两种场景流动变体在所有三个基准上都具有竞争力,同时采用比较方法中最小的培训组合。
基于RGB的DA3变体在更硬的真实动态基准上特别强,说明被冻结的DA3令牌已经支持了可靠的密密的4D运动读取.
被缝合的变体在受控合成基准上表现最出色,并仍然位于动态复制物上方的顶部附近,这很重要,因为它是联合视频训练中使用的解码器接口.
图3的质量结果显示,边界较清洁,清晰的运动较为稳定,全球立体结构比基线更好。
总的来说,这些结果证实了4D计划的第一步: DA3可以从几何重建被扩展为强活性的4D读取,这种能力基本上能活到潜入到几何缝接步骤.

blocks.en:
Table 2: Stitched Geometry Decoder Evaluation. 3D foundation models such as VGGT [ 92 ] and DA3 [ 64 ] calculate 3D metrics using raw RGB inputs. The remaining three approaches decode geometry from intermediate feature spaces. Gen3R-VAE [ 37 ] accomplishes this by projecting and reconstructing VGGT tokens.
VIST3A-Stitched [ 29 ] and our method directly process Wan video latents to decode scene geometry.

表2:硬化几何解码器评价. VGGT [92] 和DA3 [64]等3D基础模型使用原始RGB输入计算出3D公分量. 其余三个取道从中间地物空间解码出几何. GEN3R-VAE [37]通过投影和再造VGGT标志来完成这个任务.
VIST3A-被夹 [29] 和我们的方法直接处理 湾视频潜伏 解码场景几何。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison on ETH3D (top) and ScanNet++ (bottom). Our stitched decoder preserves DA3-like surface layout and scene structure more faithfully than the other aligned decoders.
blocks.zh: 图4:关于ETH3D(上)和ScanNet++(下)的质量比较。 我们缝合的解码器比其他对齐的解码器更忠实地保存了DA3型地表布局和场景结构.

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether replacing DA3’s RGB input with Wan video latents preserves its depth, camera, and reconstruction behavior on held-out benchmarks.
We compare against the latest state-of-the-art RGB-based DA3 and VGGT, and the aligned VIST3A-Stitched and Gen3R-VAE decoders. Table 2 shows that our decoder remains closer to the RGB-based models than prior aligned decoders across all three geometry families.
It slightly exceeds DA3 on Dynamic-RE10K camera estimation and remains competitive with VGGT on Dynamic Replica.
Depth changes little on MOVi-F and declines moderately on RobbySimVal.
Reconstruction shifts are larger, but our decoder remains closer to DA3 and VGGT in most settings and achieves the best completeness on Dynamic Replica. Figure 4 shows that our decoder preserves DA3-like surface layout and global scene organization, while competing aligned models produce less faithful structure.
This preserved geometry allows the frozen decoder to provide stable supervision for the video generator directly from latent rollouts.
blocks.zh:
我们评价DA3的RGB输入是否用Wan的视频潜想来保存其深度、相机和重建行为。
我们比较最新的最先进的基于RGB的DA3和VGGT,以及相适应的VIST3A-Stitched和Gen3R-VAE解码器. 表2显示,我们的解码器仍然更接近基于RGB的模型,而不是所有三个几何系的先前对齐的解码器.
它在动态-RE10K相机估计上略高于DA3,在动态复制上仍然与VGGT有竞争力.
深度在MOVi-F上变化不大,在RobbySimVal上略有下降.
重建分流较大,但我们的解码器在大多数场合仍然更接近DA3和VGGT,并在动态复制上实现最佳完整性. 图4显示,我们的解码器保留了DA3类地表布局和全球场景组织,而相竞争的对接模型则产生不太忠实的结构.
这种保存的几何方法使被冻结的解码器能够直接从潜在的推出中为视频生成器提供稳定的监控.

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports a compact subset of the full joint 4D generation benchmark in Table 8 .
The subset covers HoiGen, Epic-Kitchens-100, Dynamic Replica, and PointOdyssey across video quality, depth and reconstruction, and camera estimation.
On the 100 five-second Epic-Kitchens-100 clips, Plan4D leads on 10 of the 13 metrics in the full comparison.
On video quality, Plan4D achieves the best subject consistency on all four datasets and the best caption similarity on Epic-Kitchens-100 and PointOdyssey.
VIST3A has the highest caption similarity on HoiGen and Dynamic Replica.
On Epic-Kitchens-100, Plan4D also achieves the best background consistency and image quality, while TesserAct has the best motion smoothness and VIST3A the highest aesthetic quality.
These results show that the shared latent rollout supports strong visual consistency and action-text alignment across diverse scenes.
blocks.zh:
表3报告了表8中全部联合四维生成基准的紧凑子集。
该子集涵盖HoiGen,Epic-Kitchens-100,动态复制,以及跨越视频质量,深度和重建以及相机估计的PointOdyssey.
在100分5秒Epic-Kitchens-100的剪辑上,Plan4D在全面对比中领先了13个度量衡中的10个.
在视频质量方面,Plan4D在所有四个数据集上都实现了最佳的主题一致性,并在Epic-Kitchens-100和PointOdyssey上实现了最佳标题相似.
VIST3A在"HoiGen"和"动态复制"上具有最高的字幕相似性.
在Epic-Kitchens-100上,计划4 D还实现了最佳背景一致性和图像质量,而Tesser Act拥有最佳运动平滑度和VIST3A最高美学质量.
这些结果表明,共享的潜在推出支持了不同场景之间强烈的视觉一致性和行动文本相接。

blocks.en:
For depth and reconstruction, Plan4D gives the lowest AbsRel on all four datasets in the subset.
It also obtains the best Chamfer-L1 on Epic-Kitchens-100, Dynamic Replica, and PointOdyssey, while Gen3R has the lowest Chamfer-L1 on HoiGen.
On Epic-Kitchens-100, Plan4D leads on all three depth metrics.
The HoiGen exception separates local reconstruction quality from the full world-generation objective.
Gen3R can produce a strong point-cloud distance on one hand-object benchmark, but its video quality and camera stability are much weaker in the same setting.
blocks.zh:
对于深度和重建,Plan4D在子集中所有四个数据集上给出了最低的AbsRel.
它还在Epic-Kitchens-100,Dynamic Replica,和PointOdyssey上获得了最好的Chamfer-L1,而Gen3R在HoiGen上拥有最低的Chamfer-L1.
在Epic-Kitchens-100上,Plan4D领先于所有三个深度度量衡.
HoiGen例外将当地重建质量与完整的世界代目标区分开来.
Gen3R可以在一手对象基准上产生出强烈的点-云相距,但其视频质量和相机稳定性在同一个环境下会更弱.

blocks.en:
Camera metrics show the largest gap in global 4D consistency. Plan4D obtains the best RRA@5 on all four datasets in the subset and the best RPE-R on HoiGen, Dynamic Replica, and PointOdyssey.
On Epic-Kitchens-100, it leads on both relative-rotation accuracy thresholds.
TesserAct has the lowest RPE-R on Epic-Kitchens-100, while Plan4D maintains strong performance across datasets and metric families.
The Epic-Kitchens-100 results complement HoiGen with quantitative evidence across two real-world human-object interaction benchmarks, supporting the applicability of Plan4D to everyday interactions beyond the original evaluation setting.
The qualitative comparisons in Figure 5 and Figure 6 show the same pattern visually: the generated RGB frames, RGB-D structure, and global dynamic point clouds remain better aligned under complex action-conditioned rollouts.
These results support the core design choice of supervising a pretrained video generator with a frozen geometric readout rather than learning dense 4D structure from scratch.
blocks.zh:
相机测量显示全球4D一致性差距最大. Plan4D在子集所有四个数据集上获得最佳RRA@5,在HoiGen,动态复制和PointOdyssey上获得最佳RPE-R.
在Epic-Kitchens-100上,它引导两个相对旋转精度阈值.
Tesser Act在Epic-Kitchens-100上拥有最低的RTE-R,而Plan4D则保持了各数据集和公制家族的强效.
Epic-Kitchens-100结果在HoiGen中补充了两个现实世界人与对象交互基准的定量证据,支持Plan4D适用于原评价设定之外的日常交互.
图5和图6中的质量比较显示同样的模式:生成的RGB框架、RGB-D结构以及全球动态点云在复杂的行动条件下的推出下仍然更加一致。
这些结果支持了核心设计选择,即监督一个具有被冷冻几何读取功能的预先训练的视频生成器,而不是从零开始学习密集的4D结构.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct an ablation study to understand the contribution of each component in our joint-training objective.
The results are summarized in Table 4 ,
with results on HoiGen and Dynamic Replica using the same action-conditioned generation protocol.
The RGB-only variant retains strong subject and background consistency, but its depth and camera estimates are less accurate than those of the full model on both datasets. The geometry-only variant improves depth on HoiGen, but sacrifices visual consistency and performs worse across all reported metrics on Dynamic Replica.
The full objective gives the best subject and background consistency and camera estimation on both datasets, and also leads on depth on Dynamic Replica.
These results support combining flow matching with geometric supervision to preserve action-conditioned video quality while improving the depth and camera structure decoded from the same future latent state.
Additional settings and analysis appear in Section C.1 .

我们进行一项减征研究,以了解我们联合培训目标中每个组成部分的贡献。
表4汇总了结果。
在HoiGen和Dynamic Replica上使用相同的动作条件生成协议的结果.
仅RGB的变体保留了强烈的主题和背景一致性,但其深度和相机估计的准确度低于两个数据集上完整的模型. 仅以几何为主的变体在HoiGen上提高了深度,但牺牲了视觉一致性,并在动态复制上报告的所有计量中表现更差.
完全目标给出了两个数据集的最佳主题和背景一致性及相机估计,也引领了动态复制的深度.
这些结果支持将流量匹配和几何监督相结合,以保持有行动条件的视频质量,同时改善从同一未来潜在状态解码的深度和相机结构。
其他设置和分析见C.1节。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce the problem of generative plannable 4D worlds , where a model must generate future scenes with rich 4D attributes,
including RGB appearance, depth, camera poses, point clouds, and scene flow,
from observed context and action descriptions.
To this end, we propose Plan4D , a unified framework that decouples the acquisition of strong geometric priors from the generation of future dynamics, then reconnects them through a stitched latent world model.
By augmenting frozen DA3 with a token-only scene-flow head and learning a latent-to-geometry stitching interface from video VAE latents to geometry tokens, Plan4D turns a pretrained video generator into an actionable 4D world model whose RGB, depth, camera rays, point clouds, and scene flow are read out from the same evolving latent state in a single feed-forward pass.
Experiments show that this design preserves strong geometric behavior while improving dense 4D world generation across scene flow, reconstruction, and action-conditioned future prediction, without requiring manual 4D annotations for action videos.
We hope this perspective helps move future world modeling beyond video-only prediction toward unified, measurable, and plannable 4D world models.

blocks.en: Appendix A Frozen DA3 Tokens Already Encode Cross-Frame Motion Cues
blocks.zh: 附录 A 被冻结的 DA3 托肯斯 已经编码了跨 Frame Motion Cues

blocks.en: The lightweight DPT scene flow head above is only useful if the frozen DA3 encoder tokens already preserve motion-relevant structure. The central question of this section is therefore simple: before any scene-flow supervision reaches the decoder, do frozen DA3 tokens already know which location in frame t + 1 t+1 corresponds to a location in frame t t ? If the answer is yes, then a shallow head can decode dense motion by reading out a representation that already contains cross-frame geometry and correspondence cues. If the answer is no, then good scene-flow predictions would have to come from the capacity of the head alone.
blocks.zh: 上面的轻量级 DPT 场景流头只有在被冻结的 DA3 编码器符已经保留了与运动相关的结构时才有用. 因此,本节的中心问题很简单:在任何场景-流量监管到达解码器之前,被冻结的DA3令牌是否已经知道帧t中哪个位置+1t+1对应帧t中某个位置? 如果答案为是,那么浅头可以通过读出一个已经包含跨框架几何和对应提示的表示来解码密集运动. 如果答案是否定的,那么好的场景流预测必须仅从头部的能力中得出.

blocks.en: To make this question concrete, let z t ​ ( p ) z_{t}(p) denote the frozen DA3 token at spatial cell p p in frame t t . Point Odyssey [ 118 ] provides ground-truth tracks, which let us identify the corresponding target cell p + p^{+} in frame t + 1 t+1 for each valid source cell p p . We then probe the token space without using the scene flow head. Our analysis uses the Point Odyssey test split with 128 clips from 5 scenes. All values in Table 5 are weighted over clips by the number of valid token pairs or valid flow tokens. Figure 7 aggregates all 6,132,636 positive pairs, 6,132,636 negative pairs, and 2,160,723 token-difference vectors.

blocks.en: We use four complementary probes, each answering a different question about the frozen representation. The first probe is correspondence similarity [ 84 ] . It asks whether a token is more similar to its true match than to an unrelated token from the next frame: s pos = cos ⁡ ( z t ​ ( p ) , z t + 1 ​ ( p + ) ) , s neg = cos ⁡ ( z t ​ ( p ) , z t + 1 ​ ( q − ) ) , s_{\mathrm{pos}}=\cos\!\bigl(z_{t}(p),z_{t+1}(p^{+})\bigr),\qquad s_{\mathrm{neg}}=\cos\!\bigl(z_{t}(p),z_{t+1}(q^{-})\bigr), (6) where q − q^{-} is a random negative sampled from frame t + 1 t+1 . This is the cleanest test of whether correspondence information is present [ 44 ] . If frozen DA3 tokens contain motion-relevant structure, the s pos s_{\mathrm{pos}} distribution should shift to the right of the s neg s_{\mathrm{neg}} distribution. The margin Δ ​ s = s pos − s neg \Delta s=s_{\mathrm{pos}}-s_{\mathrm{neg}} and the probability Pr ⁡ ( s pos > s neg ) \Pr(s_{\mathrm{pos}}>s_{\mathrm{neg}}) summarize how reliably the two distributions separate.

blocks.en: The second probe is token retrieval [ 74 ] . Instead of comparing one positive and one negative, we search over all target tokens in frame t + 1 t+1 : p ^ = arg ⁡ max q ∈ 𝒫 t + 1 ⁡ cos ⁡ ( z t ​ ( p ) , z t + 1 ​ ( q ) ) . \hat{p}=\arg\max_{q\in\mathcal{P}_{t+1}}\cos\!\bigl(z_{t}(p),z_{t+1}(q)\bigr). (7) This is a stronger operational test. It asks whether nearest-neighbor search in frozen token space can recover the correct destination cell. We report Top-1 exact , which measures whether the retrieved cell is exactly the ground-truth cell, and PCK@1 and PCK@3 , which measure whether retrieval falls within 1 or 3 token cells of the ground-truth location [ 107 ] . High retrieval accuracy means that the token space is not only separable on average, but also organized enough to support direct correspondence lookup.

blocks.en: The third probe is a token-flow readout . After retrieval returns p ^ \hat{p} , we interpret it as a token-level motion estimate d ^ = p ^ − p \hat{d}=\hat{p}-p and compare it with the ground-truth token displacement. This probe is more demanding than similarity or retrieval because it asks a single nearest-neighbor lookup to act as a motion predictor. The resulting endpoint error and direction cosine should be interpreted as evidence for how directly motion can be read out from the frozen tokens without a learned decoder [ 104 ] .
blocks.zh: 第三个探测器是一个符号流读出。 检索返回 p ^\ hat{p} 后, 我们把它解释为一个符号级运动估计 d ^ = p → p → p\ hat{d> hat{p}-p , 并将其与地- 地- 地- 地- 地- 值位移相比较 。 这个探测器比相似性或检索性更要求,因为它要求一个最接近的邻居进行搜索,作为运动预测器. 由此产生的端点误差和取向余弦应被解释为没有学会的解码器[104] 如何从被冻结的符号上直接读出运动的证据.

blocks.en: The fourth probe is PCA on token differences . For each matched pair, we form Δ ​ z t ​ ( p ) = z t + 1 ​ ( p + ) − z t ​ ( p ) . \Delta z_{t}(p)=z_{t+1}(p^{+})-z_{t}(p). (8) We then perform PCA on these token differences [ 78 ] . This analysis does not test whether motion is present at all. The earlier probes already answer that question more directly. Instead, PCA asks a more specific question: is the motion signal concentrated in a small linear subspace, or is it distributed across many token dimensions? If the first few principal components explain most of the variance, then motion could be close to linearly disentangled [ 2 ] . If the variance remains spread out, then motion is still present, but encoded in a more distributed form. This distinction matters for interpreting the role of the DPT head. A low-dimensional linear code would be easy to read out with almost any linear probe, while a distributed code benefits from structured multiscale decoding.
blocks.zh: 第四个探测器是PCP, 每对配对,我们形成 z t (p) = z t + 1 (p +)- z t (p.). \Delta z_{t} (p)=z_{t+1} (p^{+})-z_{t} (p. (8) 然后我们就这些象征性差异履行常设仲裁法院[78]。 这一分析没有检验运动是否确实存在。 早期的探测器已经更直接地回答了这个问题. 相反,PCA提出了更具体的问题:运动信号是集中在一个小的线性子空间上,还是分布在许多符号维度上? 如果前几个主要元件解释出大部分差异,那么运动可能接近线性分解[2]. 如果差异仍然被分散,那么运动仍然存在,但以更分布的形式编码. 这种区别对于解释预防酷刑司负责人的作用至关重要。 使用几乎任何线性探测器都很容易读出低维线性代码,而分布式代码则从结构化多尺度解码中受益.

blocks.en: Table 5: Dataset-level evidence from frozen DA3 tokens on the Point Odyssey test split. Each block should be read differently. Similarity measures token-level separability between true matches and negatives. Retrieval measures whether nearest-neighbor search recovers the correct target cell. Token flow measures how well that retrieval can be turned into a direct motion estimate. PCA measures whether motion is concentrated in a small linear subspace.
blocks.zh: 表5:被冰冻的DA3令牌在Point Odyssey测试分出时的数据集级证据. 每个区块应作不同的解读。 相似度测量真匹配和负匹配之间的符号级可分性. 检索测量近邻搜索是否恢复了正确的目标单元格. 脚本流度测量检索能在多大程度上转化为直接运动估计. PCA测量运动是否集中在一个小的线性子空间.

blocks.en: Before discussing the numbers, it is useful to clarify how they should be interpreted. Similarity and retrieval are the strongest probes in this section because they make the fewest modeling assumptions. They only ask whether true cross-frame matches are already nearby in frozen token space. Token flow is a harder probe because it asks nearest-neighbor retrieval to behave like a motion estimator. PCA is the most indirect probe because a failure to find a low-dimensional linear motion axis does not mean that motion information is absent. It only means that the information is not cleanly isolated in the top principal components.
blocks.zh: 在讨论这些数字之前,有必要澄清如何解释这些数字。 相似性和取回性是本节中最强的探测器,因为它们的建模假设最少. 他们只问真正的跨框相配是否已经在被冻结的活字空间附近. 托肯流是一个更难的探针,因为它要求近邻取回像运动估计器一样的行为. PCA是最间接的探测器,因为找不到低维线性运动轴并不意味着运动信息是缺失的. 这仅仅意味着信息在顶级主要组件中并没有被干净地隔离.

blocks.en: Figure 7 and Table 5 provide direct evidence that frozen DA3 tokens preserve cross-frame correspondence structure. The similarity distributions are cleanly separated, with ground-truth matches consistently closer in token space than random negatives. Nearest-neighbor retrieval leads to the same conclusion under a stronger all-candidates test. These two probes show that, even without any learned motion decoder, the frozen representation already places true future matches near the source token and usually retrieves a target very close to the correct location.
blocks.zh: 图7和表5提供了直接证据,说明被冻结的DA3令牌保留了跨框架通信结构。 相似性分布是干净地分开的,地面-真实性匹配在象征空间中始终比随机负数更接近. 近邻取回在更强大的所有候选人考试下得出同样的结论. 这两个探测器显示,即使没有任何学会的运动解码器,被冻结的表示已经将真实的未来匹配物放入出源符附近,并且通常会取回一个非常接近正确位置的目标.

blocks.en: The token-flow probe refines this picture. A simple nearest-neighbor displacement readout already recovers meaningful motion, which indicates that the frozen tokens encode where points are likely to move. At the same time, this probe is weaker than similarity and retrieval, which suggests that the motion signal is not exposed as a trivial one-step velocity code. This is precisely where a structured decoder becomes useful. Our DPT head can pool multiscale context and impose spatial coherence to transform this latent correspondence signal into dense scene flow.
blocks.zh: 符号流探测器改进了这张照片. 一个简单的近邻移位读出已经恢复了有意义的运动,这说明被冻结的活符编码了点可能移动的地方. 同时,这个探测器比相似性和回取性更弱,这表明运动信号不作为微不足道的一步速度码被曝光. 这正是结构化解码器变得有用的地方. 我们的DPT头可以集合多尺度上下文,并强制要求空间一致性来将这种潜在的通信信号转化为密集的场景流.

blocks.en: The PCA results should be read as auxiliary evidence. The dominant components explain only a limited portion of the token-difference variance, and their alignment with flow magnitude remains weak. This does not argue against motion information in the frozen tokens. Instead, PCA indicates that motion is encoded in a distributed high-dimensional form rather than concentrated in a single linear direction.
blocks.zh: PCA结果应被理解为辅助证据. 占优势的成分只解释了象征-偏差差异的有限部分,它们与流量的相接性仍然很弱. 这并不反对在被冻结的代币中移动信息。 相反,PCA表示运动被编码为分布式高维相,而不是集中在单一线性方向上.

blocks.en: These results support a precise interpretation of our method. Frozen DA3 encoder tokens already contain scene-flow-relevant information, especially in the form of cross-frame correspondence structure. The strongest evidence comes from the probes that require almost no decoder assumptions, namely similarity separation and nearest-neighbor retrieval. The weaker token-flow and PCA probes refine this picture. They suggest that the motion signal is real, but distributed and not trivially linearized. Our DPT head succeeds because it decodes and regularizes this latent signal into dense metric predictions. In other words, the scene flow branch acts as an informed readout of the pretrained geometry representation, rather than a separate module that has to create motion information from scratch.
blocks.zh: 这些结果有助于准确解释我们的方法。 被冻结的DA3编码器符已经包含与场景流量相關的信息,特别是以跨帧通信结构的形式. 最强的证据来自几乎不需要解码假设的探测器,即相似性分离和近邻取回. 较弱的信号流和五氯苯甲醚探测器改进了这一画面。 他们认为运动信号是真实的,但分布不小,线性不小. 我们的DPT头成功 因为它解码 并将这个潜在的信号规范化 成为密集的度量预测 换句话说,场景流分会起到对被预先训练出几何表示的知情读出的作用,而不是一个必须从零开始创建运动信息的单独的模块.

blocks.en: All dataset statistics in this paper correspond to the 81-frame manifests. Every manifest row therefore satisfies the temporal constraint T = 4 ​ k + 1 T=4k+1 with T = 81 T=81 . Table 6 summarizes the stage-wise training data. Stage 1 trains only the DA3 scene-flow readout. Stage 2 finetunes the stitched decoder with hybrid ground-truth and teacher-student supervision. Stage 3 optimizes the action-conditioned video model, where Action100M contributes text-conditioned video clips without paired 4D labels.
blocks.zh: 本文件中的所有数据集统计都符合81个框架清单。 因此,每个表列都满足了时间约束 T = 4克+ 1 T = 4克+1, T = 81 T = 81. 表6汇总了分阶段培训数据。 第1阶段列车仅进行DA3场景流程读取. 第2阶段对被缝合的解码器进行微调,采用混合地面真伪和师生监督. 第3阶段优化了有动作条件的视频模型,其中Action100M提供文字条件的视频片段而无需配对4D标签.

blocks.en: Table 6: Stage-wise training datasets for the 81-frame Plan4D pipeline. Counts are the effective rows used in each stage. Stage 1 keeps only clips with scene_flow_available=true , while Stage 2 uses the same GT-capable manifests to build a GT branch and a distillation branch, so one hybrid epoch traverses the full mixture once under GT supervision and once under teacher-student supervision.
blocks.zh: 表6:81框架计划4D管道的分阶段培训数据集。 计数是每个阶段使用的有效行. 第1阶段只保留有 scene_flow_access=real的片段,而第2阶段则使用相同的GT能力表单来构建GT分支和分馏分支,因此一个混合纪元一次在GT监管下和一次在师生监管下穿越了完整的混合物.

blocks.en: Stage 1 mixes 11,956 training clips from five dynamic datasets. The sampler uses dataset-wise mixture weights of 1.0 together with a size-aware mixing exponent α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 , which interpolates between uniform-over-datasets and proportional-to-size sampling. The stage-1 manifest directory also contains held-out or diagnostic subsets such as PointOdyssey test, PointOdyssey sample, and Dynamic Replica valid clips for validation and smoke tests.

blocks.en: Stage 2 contains 122,225 GT-capable training clips. Among them, 13,521 clips expose scene-flow labels, while the remaining 108,704 clips provide only depth, ray, camera, and point-cloud supervision. In hybrid decoder training, we build separate GT and distill dataloaders from the same manifest list and randomly shuffle the union of GT and distill steps once per epoch. This realizes one GT pass and one distillation pass over the full mixture in a single hybrid epoch.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段包含122 225GT能力培训剪辑. 其中13,521个片段暴露出场景流出标签,而其余108,704个片段则仅提供深度,射线,相机,和点-云监督. 在混合解码器训练中,我们从同一个表单中建造了单独的GT和蒸馏数据装载器,并随机洗涤了GT的结合并蒸馏步骤,每个纪元一次. 这实现了一个GT通过,一个蒸馏通过,在一个单一的混合纪元中通过完整的混合物.

blocks.en: The stage-3 Action100M subset is constructed in two steps. We first start from the filtered 81-frame TI2V manifest action100m_train_ti2v_81f.filtered.jsonl , whose rows already satisfy task_type=ti2v , cond_frames=1 , and num_frames=81 . We then score the corresponding clip-level entries from action100m_clip_index_81f.filtered.jsonl and keep only clips that pass a high-precision action-quality filter. The clip-level decision uses fields such as prompt_action , level , and node_duration_sec . We drop clips with node duration shorter than 1.6 seconds, hierarchy depth above 10, missing action text, action text identical to the generic description, action text shorter than four words, prompt patterns dominated by on-screen text or audio-style narration, uncertain descriptions, or generic action stubs. The retained manifest action100m_train_ti2v_81f.action_hq.keep.jsonl contains 249,422 clips, which is 28.6% of the 871,785 filtered TI2V rows. Because Action100M does not provide paired 4D geometry, these clips are used only in the distillation branch during stage 3.
blocks.zh: 阶段3 行动100 M子集分两步构建. 我们首先从过滤的 81-帧 TI2V 显示的 action100m_train_ti2v_81f.filtered.jsonl 开始,其行已满足任务_type=ti2v,cond_frames=1,和num_frames=81. 然后我们从 action100m_clip_index_81f.filtered.jsonl 中分出相应的剪接级别条目,并只保留通过高精度动作质量过滤的剪接. 剪贴级决定使用"即时"等字段,"级"和"节点"等. 我们放下短于1.6秒的节点长度,分级深度为10分以上,缺少动作文字,动作文字与通用描述完全相同,动作文字短于4个单词,由屏幕上文字或音频风格的描述为主的即时图案,不确定描述,或通用动作活字根. 所保留的表单动作100m_train_ti2v_81f.action_hq.keep.jsonl包含249,422个片段,是871,785个被过滤的TI2V行的28.6%. 因为行动100 M不提供配对的4D几何,这些片段只在第3阶段的分馏分支中使用.

blocks.en: PointOdyssey provides articulated outdoor motion with sparse track supervision that we rasterize into dense forward scene flow, which makes it particularly useful for supervising correspondence-aware motion. Dynamic Replica contributes denser dynamic stereo geometry with strong camera and scene-flow signals. BlinkVision, Virtual KITTI 2, and OmniWorld broaden the synthetic motion distribution across indoor scenes, driving scenes, and open-world gameplay trajectories. ScanNet++ and MVS-Synth do not provide scene flow in our 81-frame setup, but they substantially enrich multiview depth, camera, and point-cloud supervision during stitched-decoder finetuning. Action100M serves a different purpose from the geometry datasets. It injects large-scale action-conditioned video semantics into the joint model while relying on the frozen DA3 teacher for geometric targets.
blocks.zh: PointOdyssey提供清晰的室外运动, 并有稀疏的轨道监督, 我们将光栅化成密集的前向场景流, 这使得它特别有用 监督函电感知运动。 动态复制能用强相机和场景流信号来贡献更密集的动态立体几何. BlinkVision,Virtual KITTI 2和OmniWorld将合成运动分布拓宽到室内场景,驾驶场景,和开放世界的游戏游戏轨迹. ScanNet++和MVS-Synth在我们的81帧设置中不提供场景流,但它们在缝合解码器微调时大大丰富了多视图深度,相机和点-云监督. Action100M服务于与几何数据集不同的目的. 它在依赖被冻结的DA3老师进行几何目标的同时,向联合模型中注入了大规模有动作条件的视频语义.

blocks.en: We report three groups of held-out evaluations. For dynamic 4D motion, we evaluate on MOVi-F, Dynamic Replica, and PointOdyssey using 81-frame clips. MOVi-F tests controlled synthetic object motion, Dynamic Replica tests realistic dynamic stereo scenes, and PointOdyssey emphasizes articulated motion with long temporal support. For stitched-decoder geometry preservation, we evaluate on ETH3D, ScanNet++, Dynamic Replica, Dynamic-RE10K, MOVi-F, and RobbySimVal. These datasets cover static reconstruction, indoor multiview geometry, dynamic camera estimation, and robot-centric depth prediction. For action-conditioned world generation, we evaluate on RLBench with 210 samples, HOIGen-1M with 200 samples, Dynamic Replica with 480 samples, and PointOdyssey with 375 samples, which together span manipulation, hand-object interaction, and general dynamic-scene futures. We additionally evaluate 100 five-second Epic-Kitchens-100 clips to assess in-the-wild generalization to everyday human-object interactions in kitchen environments. This evaluation complements HoiGen with a second real-world human-object interaction benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们报告三组搁置的评价。 对于动态4D运动,我们对MOVi-F,动态复制(Dynamic Replica),和PointOdyssey使用81帧剪接进行评价. MOVi-F测试可控的合成物体运动,动态复制测试现实的动态立体场景,而PointOdyssey则强调有长时间支持的清晰的运动. 对于缝接-解码器几何保存,我们评价了ETH3D,ScanNet++,动态复制,动态-RE10K,MOVi-F,和RobbySimVal. 这些数据集涵盖静态重建,室内多景几何,动态相机估计,和以机器人为中心的深度预测. 对于具备行动条件的世界一代,我们用210个样本在RL Bench上进行评估,HoIGen-1M样本为200个,动态复制样本为480个,PointOdyssey样本为375个,它们共同跨越了操纵,手物体相互作用,以及一般动态-场面未来. 我们还评估了100个5秒的Epic-Kitchens-100片段,以评估厨房环境中人类物体日常相互作用的模糊性。 本评价以第二个现实世界人类对象互动基准来补充HoiGen.

blocks.en: We exclude several recent world-generation systems from the stage-3 comparison because they assume additional control inputs beyond the setting targeted in this paper. PointWorld requires depth input [ 41 ] . FantasyWorld, HY-World 2.0, Lyra 2.0, Geometry Forcing, and TeleWorld rely on trajectory-level control signals [ 22 , 43 , 80 , 100 , 20 ] . Kinema4D further requires robot-action kinematic representations [ 105 ] . These methods therefore do not match the task of predicting future RGB video together with dense 4D geometry from only an observed scene context and a text-specified action, so we do not include them in the stage-3 comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们把最近几个世界代系统排除在第三阶段的比较之外,因为这些系统承担了超出本文件所定范围的额外控制投入。 PointWorld需要深度输入[41]. Fantasy World,HY-World 2.0,Lyra 2.0,几何强制,和TeleWorld依赖轨迹级控制信号[22,43,80,100,20]. 基内马4 D进一步要求机器人动作动能表达[105]. 因此,这些方法与预测未来RGB视频的任务不相匹配,加上仅从被观测到的场景上下文和文本指定动作中产生的稠密的4D几何,因此我们没有将它们包含在舞台-3比较中.

blocks.en: 3D reconstruction. Reconstruction also follows the official DA3 bench. We estimate a global Umeyama alignment between predicted and ground-truth camera trajectories and use the recovered scale to place predicted depth in metric units before TSDF fusion. When predicted poses are used for reconstruction, the same fit also aligns the fused camera trajectory. The fused prediction is then compared with the benchmark ground-truth geometry using the dataset-specific threshold and downsampling settings from the DA3 bench. ETH3D and ScanNet++ evaluate against points sampled from the ground-truth mesh, and ScanNet++ additionally crops the predicted point cloud to the ground-truth bounding box with a small margin before scoring. blocks.en: Joint world generation. For RGB video quality, higher video-caption similarity indicates stronger alignment between the generated video and the conditioning action text. RLBench and HOIGen-1M use their native action annotations, while Dynamic Replica and PointOdyssey do not provide action-level text in our stage-3 evaluation split, so we generate per-clip action captions with Qwen-VL-30B-Thinking and use them as the conditioning text for all compared methods. When a baseline exposes a compatible geometry output, we score its generated 4D structure with the same geometry protocol described above.
blocks.zh: 联合世界一代. 对于RGB的视频质量,更高的视频封装相似性表明生成的视频和调制动作文本之间更加一致. RL Bench和HOIGen-1M使用本作的动作说明,而Dynamic Replica和PointOdyssey则不提供我们阶段-3评价分出中的动作级别文本,因此我们生成了每个clip的动作标题并使用Quen-VL-30B-思考,并将其作为所有比较方法的调制文本. 当基线暴露出相容的几何输出时,我们用上述相同的几何协议对其产生的4D结构进行分分.

blocks.en: We sample 100 clips, each five seconds long, and follow the same action-conditioned joint 4D generation protocol as the original comparison. Each method receives the initial RGB frame and an action description. We compare Plan4D , TesserAct, Gen3R, and VIST3A using the same metric definitions and alignment procedures. The full evaluation reports six video metrics, namely subject consistency (SC), background consistency (BC), aesthetic quality (AQ), image quality (IQ), motion smoothness (MS), and video-caption similarity (Cap.Sim). Geometry is evaluated with depth AbsRel, δ 1 \delta_{1} , δ 2 \delta_{2} , and Chamfer-L1, together with camera RPE-R, RRA@10, and RRA@5. Higher scores are better except for AbsRel, Chamfer-L1, and RPE-R. The complete results appear in Table 8 , and Table 3 retains six representative metrics for comparison with the other benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们抽取了100个片段,每5秒长,并遵循与原始比较相同的行动条件联合4D生成协议. 每种方法都得到初始RGB框架和动作描述. 我们使用相同的计量定义和校正程序来比较Plan4D、Tester Act、Gen3R和VIST3A。 完整的评价报告六个视频衡量标准,即主题一致性(SC)、背景一致性(BC)、美学质量(AQ)、图像质量(IQ)、运动平滑性(MS)和视频封装相似性(Cap.Sim)。 几何学以深度AbsRel、\\\ delta\ 1}、\ \ 2\ delta\ 2} 和 Chamfer-L1 以及相机RPE-R、RRA@10和RRA@5来评估。 较高的分数优于AbsRel,Chamfer-L1和RPE-R. 全部结果载于表8,表3保留了六个具有代表性的衡量标准,以便与其他基准进行比较。

blocks.en: For stage 1, the 81-frame manifest configuration uses AdamW with learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , 100 warmup steps, gradient accumulation 2, and bf16 mixed precision. Inputs are resized to 504 × 504 504\times 504 with upper-bound resizing, the clip overlap is 1 frame, and the scene-flow loss adds a zero-last-frame penalty with weight 0.1. The main paper reports a 20-epoch run on 16 H100 GPUs with per-GPU batch size 1.

blocks.en: For stage 2, the stitched-decoder hybrid launchers use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , bf16 mixed precision, 504 × 504 504\times 504 inputs, and per-GPU batch size 1. The representative 81-frame launchers use a 50-step warmup and train the stitching layer together with LoRA adapters on the stitched DA3 blocks by default, while still supporting full finetuning of the stitched parts. The main paper reports one hybrid epoch on 64 H20 GPUs.

blocks.en: For stage 3, the stitched joint LoRA launcher uses AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , cosine decay, 1000 warmup steps, LoRA rank 32 on the DiT, gradient checkpointing, 81 frames at 532 × 532 532\times 532 resolution, condition dropout 0.1, and geometry-loss warmup from 0.001 to 1.0 over the first 500 steps. We apply mask_condition_loss on conditioned prefixes and geo_supervise_generated_only on the generated suffix. The main paper reports one epoch on 64 H20 GPUs with per-GPU batch size 1.

blocks.en: B.2 Scene Flow Head Training
blocks.zh: B.2 场景流程头培训

blocks.en: We train the scene-flow branch as a readout on top of a fixed DA3 representation. The DA3 backbone, depth head, ray head, and camera modules are loaded from the pretrained checkpoint and kept frozen. We inject the DPT-style scene-flow head and its coordinate adapter from the scene-flow preset, load the original DA3 weights with non-strict matching, and optimize only the parameters of the new head. During training, each clip is passed through the frozen DA3 encoder to extract the four multiscale token maps. The head decodes these tokens into a dense three-channel motion field, and the adapter rotates the local camera-frame prediction into the first-frame camera basis.
blocks.zh: 我们训练场景流程分支 作为读出 在固定DA3代表。 DA3主干线,深度头,射线头,相机模块被从经过预先训练的检查站装入并被冻结. 我们从场景流预设中注入了DPT风格的场景流头及其坐标适配器,以非限制性匹配方式加载了原DA3重量,并优化了新头的参数. 在训练期间,每个片段会被通过被冻结的DA3编码器来取出四个多比例符号地图. 头部将这些活字解码为密集的三相道运动场,适配器将局部相机帧预测旋转为一相机基础.

blocks.en: The training target is a forward displacement field from frame t t to frame t + 1 t+1 . All datasets expose the same fields: RGB frames, camera intrinsics, world-to-camera extrinsics, a scene-flow tensor, a per-clip scale, and a binary deformation mask. We use relative scene flow by default. Metric displacements are expressed in the first-frame camera basis and normalized by a robust clip-level scale, which makes the head less sensitive to the absolute size of a scene.

blocks.en: B.3 Latent-to-Geometry Model Stitching Training
blocks.zh: B.3 近地对地测量模型跳槽培训

blocks.en: The stitching stage determines where the video latent space should enter DA3 and initializes the projection into that token space. For each training clip, we encode the RGB video with the frozen Wan VAE and extract candidate DA3 token maps from encoder blocks. The Wan latent has 16 channels and is temporally compressed. Before fitting the stitch, we upsample it back to the video frame rate with T = 4 ​ ( T vae − 1 ) + 1 T=4(T_{\mathrm{vae}}-1)+1 and resize it to the spatial resolution required by the DA3 patch grid.
blocks.zh: 缝合阶段决定了影视潜入空间应在何地输入DA3并初始化投影到该符号空间. 对于每个训练片段,我们用被冻结的Wan VAE编码了RGB视频,并从编码器块取出候选的DA3符号地图. 万能潜伏器有16个通道 时间上是压缩的 在缝合之前,我们用 T = 4 (T vae − 1) + 1 T = 4 (T _{\mathrm{vae}} 1) + 1 将其提升回视频帧速率,并调整为 DA3 补丁网格所要求的空间分辨率.

blocks.en: For each candidate block k k , we fit a 3D convolutional stitch 𝒮 θ ( k ) \mathcal{S}_{\theta}^{(k)} from the upsampled Wan latent to the frozen DA3 token grid. The fit is a streaming ridge regression problem shown in Equation 2 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选的块 kk, 我们安装一个3D 演化缝合 S \ (k )\ mathcal{ S\\theta\ (k )} 从被检测的湾潜伏到被冻结的 DA3 标志网格。 适配是"方程式2"中显示的一个流出脊回向问题.

blocks.en: The streaming solver accumulates normal-equation statistics over cached tensor batches, which avoids storing a large design matrix. We rank candidate blocks by the reconstruction mean squared error and choose the block with the lowest error. In our DA3 setting, the stitch maps the 16-channel Wan latent to the 1536-channel DA3 token width through a compact spatiotemporal convolution. This procedure gives both the injection layer and the initial weights for the later trainable stitched decoder.
blocks.zh: 流体解析器在缓存的百分数批次上积累出正常的方程统计,可避免存储一个大型设计矩阵. 我们按重建区块排列候选区块 意味着平方误差 选择最小误差的区块 在我们的DA3设置中,缝合图上,16道潜伏到1536道DA3符号宽度,通过紧凑的瞬间相接而成. 这一程序既为后期可被训练缝合的解码器提供了注射层和初始重量.

blocks.en: B.4 Stitched Decoder Finetuning
blocks.zh: B.4 硬接解码器微调

blocks.en: The linear stitch is only an initialization. We next train a stitched decoder that accepts Wan latents but preserves the geometry behavior of DA3. The Wan VAE is frozen. The pretrained DA3 teacher is frozen. The trainable student contains the stitching module and stitched DA3 parts. The video diffusion transformer is not trained in this stage.
blocks.zh: 线性缝合只是初始化. 接下来我们训练一个接缝的解码器,它接受万能潜伏,但保留了DA3的几何行为. Wan VAE被冻结了. 预训的DA3老师被冻结了. 可训练的学生包含缝合模块和被缝合的DA3部分. 视频传播变压器在这一阶段没有经过训练.

blocks.en: In the manifest-based joint setup, GT-capable geometry datasets can be used with distill , gt , or hybrid supervision modes. Action100M rows are wrapped as distill-only manifest entries with prompt metadata and no GT geometry. For the subset used in the main paper, every Action100M row is an 81-frame TI2V clip with cond_frames=1 . This design lets the video model learn long-horizon action semantics from large-scale web video while still receiving metric 4D regularization from the stitched geometry branch.

blocks.en: B.6 Model Information
blocks.zh: B.6 示范信息

blocks.en: Our system combines a large pretrained video generator with a frozen geometric readout. The dominant parameter budget comes from the LongCat-Video diffusion transformer, while the Wan VAE provides the latent video interface used by both the RGB and geometry branches. Based on the local pretrained weights used in our pipeline, the LongCat-Video DiT contains 13,581.07M parameters, and the Wan VAE contains 126.89M parameters. These two components are both frozen during stitched-decoder finetuning, and only the DiT is updated during the final joint training stage, where our main setting optimizes LoRA parameters on top of the pretrained backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们的系统结合了大型预装视频生成器和被冻结的几何读取器. 占优势的参数预算来自长卡特-视频传播变压器,而Wan VAE则提供了RGB和几何分支使用的潜在视频接口. 根据我国输油管使用的局部预限重量,"长卡通-视频DiT"包含13,581.07M参数,"Wan VAE"包含126.89M参数. 这两个构件在缝合解码器微调时都被冷冻了,最后联合训练阶段只有DiT被更新,我们的主设置在预训骨干上方优化了LORA参数.

blocks.en: The geometry branch is implemented as a stitched DA3 decoder that reads the same Wan latent trajectory and recovers depth, camera rays, camera parameters, and scene flow. This branch reuses the pretrained DA3 backbone and dense geometry heads together with our added scene-flow head and the latent-to-token stitching module. We do not count the raw DA3 teacher separately because it is only used to provide supervision during training and is not part of the inference-time Plan4D pipeline. In this sense, the deployed system consists of three principal model components: a 13.58B video diffusion transformer, a 126.89M video VAE, and a stitched geometric decoder built on top of DA3. The overall parameter budget is therefore dominated by the video backbone rather than the geometric readout.
blocks.zh: 几何分支作为缝接的DA3解码器被执行,它读取了相同的万潜轨迹并恢复了深度,相机射线,相机参数和场景流. 这个分支重新利用了预先训练的DA3主干和密集的几何头,加上我们添加的场景流量头和潜入接地缝合模块. 我们不单独计算原始的DA3教师,因为它只用于在培训期间进行监督,而不是推论时间计划4D管道的一部分。 在这个意义上,所部署的系统由三个主要的模型组件组成:一个13.58B的视频传播变压器,一个126.89M的视频VAE,以及一个由DA3上方所建的缝接几何解码器. 因此,总体参数预算以视频主干而不是几何读取为主.

Geometry-only training attains the best depth scores, but weakens subject and background consistency and has a higher camera rotation error than the full objective. Across both datasets, the full model gives the best subject and background consistency and camera estimates. These results support the complementary roles of the two losses: flow matching preserves action-conditioned visual quality, while geometric supervision regularizes the shared future latent state toward consistent depth and camera structure.

blocks.en: C.2 Ablation for Stitching Adapter Architecture
blocks.zh: C.2 安装适配器建筑

blocks.en: The stitching adapter has a narrow but important role in Plan4D . It maps the upsampled Wan VAE latent into the DA3 token space at a candidate encoder block, after which the remaining DA3 encoder and dense heads perform the geometric decoding. We therefore ask whether this interface needs a high-capacity nonlinear module, or whether the compact linear 3D convolution used in the main method is sufficient.
blocks.zh: 缝合适配器在Plan4D中具有狭义而重要的作用. 它绘制了在候选编码器块上被检测到的Wan VAE潜入DA3符号空间的地图,之后剩下的DA3编码器和密集头进行几何解码. 因此,我们询问,这种接口是否需要一个高功率的非线性模块,或者主要方法中使用的紧凑线性3D演化是否足够.

blocks.en: We compare three adapter architectures under the same cached OmniWorld-Game [ 119 ] feature sweep. Let 𝐙 ∈ ℝ B × 16 × T × H × W \mathbf{Z}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 16\times T\times H\times W} denote the temporally upsampled Wan latent, and let 𝐘 ∈ ℝ B × 1536 × T × H ′ × W ′ \mathbf{Y}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 1536\times T\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}} denote the target DA3 token features. The adapter learns a mapping 𝒜 θ : 𝐙 ↦ 𝐘 ^ , 𝐘 ^ ∈ ℝ B × 1536 × T × H ′ × W ′ . \mathcal{A}_{\theta}:\mathbf{Z}\mapsto\hat{\mathbf{Y}},\qquad\hat{\mathbf{Y}}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 1536\times T\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}}. (31) We study three designs with increasing modeling capacity. The linear adapter provides a purely local projection, the residual bottleneck augments this projection with a nonlinear correction, and the axial-attention adapter further introduces long-range mixing along the temporal and spatial axes.

(39) We then apply multi-head self-attention independently along the temporal, height, and width axes. blocks.en: Figure 8: Stitching adapter architecture ablation over DA3 encoder blocks 1–11. Lower MSE means that the adapter reconstructs the frozen DA3 feature grid more accurately from the Wan VAE latent. All three variants prefer the earliest candidate block, and the linear 3D convolution remains close to the heavier residual and attention-based adapters across the sweep.
blocks.zh: 图8:在DA3编码器区块1–11上断开适配器架构通缩. 下MSE指适配器从Wan VAE潜想中更准确地重建被冻结的DA3特征网格. 所有三种变体都更喜欢最早期的候选块,线性3D会演化仍然接近整个扫荡中更重的残余和以注意力为主的适配器.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the reconstruction MSE for blocks 1–11. All three curves have the same dominant trend. The earliest DA3 block is easiest to reach from the Wan latent, while deeper blocks become progressively harder to reconstruct. This aligns with the insight from Go et al. [29] that early 3D foundation model encoder features serve as a foundational geometric interface. This observation directly motivates our architectural design in Section 3 . By introducing the stitch at an early stage, we capture these representations before the network accumulates highly specialized geometric processing.
blocks.zh: 图8显示1至11区块的重建MSE。 三道曲线都具有相同的主导趋势. 最早的DA3区块最容易从万能潜入,而更深的区块则逐渐更难重建. 这符合Go等人的见解。 [29],早期的3D基础模型编码器特性作为基础几何界面. 这一观察直接激励了我们的建筑设计 在第三节。 通过在早期引入接缝,我们在网络积累高度专业化的几何处理之前就捕捉到这些表示.

blocks.en: The architectural comparison is more important than the absolute block ranking. At the best block, the linear 3D convolution obtains an MSE of 0.268. The residual bottleneck obtains 0.254, and axial attention obtains 0.266. Averaged over blocks 1–11, the MSEs are 0.499, 0.485, and 0.491 for the linear convolution, residual bottleneck, and axial attention variants. The nonlinear residual branch gives the lowest standalone fitting error, but the gain is small relative to the added normalization, activation, and extra convolutional layers. Axial attention is even closer to the linear convolution despite its substantially higher memory and compute cost.
blocks.zh: 建筑对比比绝对区块排名更重要. 在最优的区块上,线性3D分化得到0.268. 余下瓶颈得到0.254分,轴心注意力得到0.266分. 平均在1至11区块上,MSEs为0.499,0.485,而线性演化,残余瓶颈,轴心注意变体为0.491. 非线性残留分支给出了最小的独立安装出错,但相对于所增加的正常化,活化,和外接层而言,收益很小. 轴心的注意力甚至更接近线性演化,尽管其记忆和计算成本要高得多.

blocks.en: These results support the simpler adapter used in the main system. The stitching layer is not intended to replace the remaining DA3 decoder. Its job is to place the video latent on a compatible DA3 token manifold and provide a stable initialization for the stitched decoder finetuning stage. A linear 3D convolution already captures most of this alignment. More expressive residual or attention-based adapters provide only modest reconstruction gains, so they do not justify their additional cost for this interface.
blocks.zh: 这些结果支持了主系统使用的更简单的适配器. 缝接层并不是要替换剩余的DA3解码器. 它的工作是将视频潜入相容的DA3符号多相机,并为被缝接的解码器微调阶段提供稳定的初始化. 线性立体演化已经捕捉到大部分的这种对齐. 更显性地剩余或基于关注的适配器只能提供微小的重建收益,因此它们不能证明它们为这种接口增加费用是合理的.

blocks.en: C.3 Ablation for Stitched Decoder Finetuning Strategy
blocks.zh: C.3. 安装解码器精细调整战略

blocks.en: The stitched decoder is trained for a specific role. It must accept Wan VAE latents as input while retaining the geometric behavior of the original DA3 model. This creates a tension between adaptation and preservation. Teacher-student distillation keeps the student close to the pretrained DA3 function, while ground-truth geometric supervision anchors the predictions to metric depth, camera, point-cloud, and motion annotations when such labels are available. We ablate this finetuning strategy to identify which ingredients are needed for a stable latent-to-geometry decoder.
blocks.zh: 被缝合的解码器被训练为特定的角色. 它必须接受Wan VAE潜入作为输入,同时保留原DA3模型的几何行为. 这造成适应与保护之间的紧张关系。 师生蒸馏使学生接近预先训练的DA3功能,而地真几何监督将预测锁定在有这种标签时的度量深度,相机,点-云和运动说明. 我们放弃这种微调策略,以确定稳定地潜到地表分解器需要哪些成分。

blocks.en: We follow the same benchmarks and metrics as the main stitched-model evaluation in Table 2 . The variants isolate the main design choices in the finetuning stage. Distillation only trains the student only from the frozen DA3 teacher outputs. The teacher receives the ground-truth RGB clip, and the student receives the Wan latent of the same clip. Distillation with feature loss introduces an auxiliary feature-matching term to regularize the stitched DA3 representation. Specifically, it applies an L 1 L_{1} penalty between the output features of the stitching layer and the corresponding block features from the teacher model. This constraint forces the projected latent tokens to remain aligned with the teacher’s feature manifold prior to dense decoding. GT supervision only removes the teacher and trains only from available dataset annotations. No scene-flow head keeps the depth, ray, camera, and reconstruction objectives but removes the motion branch during stitched-decoder finetuning. LoRA adaptation replaces the full update of the stitched decoder with a parameter-efficient alternative [ 36 ] on the adapted DA3 computation path. Specifically, we apply a low-rank update with both the rank and scaling factor α \alpha set to 32 and maintain a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} .
blocks.zh: 我们遵循与表2主要搭接模式评价相同的基准和衡量标准。 变体分离出微调阶段的主要设计选择. 消沉只从冻结的DA3教师产出中培训学生。 老师收到地面真实的RGB片段,学生收到同片片段的万潜. 特征损失的分解引入了一个辅助特征比对术语来规范被缝合的DA3代表. 具体来说,它在缝合层的输出特征和从师范模型中对应的块状特征之间应用了L 1 LQQQ1}的处罚. 这种限制迫使所预测的潜在标志在密集解码之前与教师的特征成倍一致。 GT 監督只去除老师,而只从可用的数据集说明中去除列车. 没有任何场景流头保留了深度,射线,相机,和重建目标,但在被缝合解码器微调时会去掉运动分支. LoRA的适应在被调整后的DA3计算路径上用一个参数高效的替代品[36]来取代被缝接的解码器的全部更新. 具体地说,我们采用了一个低级更新,分级和分级系数α-α设置到32,并且保持1×10−4 1\times 10×4}的学习率。

The table reports representative reconstruction and camera metrics that diagnose metric 3D preservation and dynamic-scene camera stability. In each metric column, the best value is highlighted in red and bold, the second-best value in orange, and the third-best value in yellow.
